entries.title: Base44 dev environment
entries.summary: # Base44 dev environment Two-process app. The canonical UI is Next.js 16 (App Router) in `src/`; the listing API is a plain Node `http` server in `server/`. They share one `package.json` / `node_modules`. - `npm run dev` → `next dev -p 3001` (canonical UI, port 3001 locally).
